validation_status: PROPOSED — pending implementation checklist box 4 (reproducibility-only baseline check per candidate). The exact source-file counts, test runtimes, and bug-fix PR labels listed below are best-effort estimates from the proposing agent's knowledge cutoff; the dry-run is the source of truth and MUST validate every per-repo entry before this pool is locked. Repos that fail dry-run get excluded with the failed-check name recorded; remaining ≥4 carry into the bench.
selection_criteria_summary: Public GitHub; permissive license (MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD-3 / ISC); ≥30 bug-fix PRs in last 24 months; reproducible test command ≤5 min on warm cache; 50-2000 source files (excluding tests/vendor/node_modules); last commit ≤6 months old; primary language TypeScript / JavaScript / Python.
selection_principle: Span ≥2 of {TS, JS, Py} and ≥2 size buckets; favor fast deterministic local tests; avoid huge / slow / infra-heavy repos.
diversity_note: Two repos per language; one repo in the 'medium' bucket (mathjs) and five in 'small'. No 'large' bucket pick — keeping all repos fast and deterministic is the higher-value criterion at this N. The undici → sinon swap (operator decision) traded the JS-medium slot for a smaller, faster, more deterministic JS mocking library; this concentrates 'medium' to a single repo (mathjs) but reduces test-runtime risk across the pool. If a later iteration needs more medium / large coverage, candidates like python-poetry/poetry or pytest-dev/pytest could be evaluated separately.

repos.selection_rationale: Replaces nodejs/undici (operator decision after pool review). Mature, focused JS mocking library with very fast deterministic tests. Bug-fix PRs land on small, scoped files (spy.js, stub.js, fakes/timers.js, etc.) — clear file ownership is exactly the navigation pattern file_memory should help with. Trade-off: gives up the JS-medium slot (undici was ~200 files), keeping mathjs as the sole 'medium' bucket repo; in return, gains substantially lower setup-risk and faster per-trajectory wall-time.
